name: Attias Oven Corp.
old_description: Rely on the specialists at Attias Oven Corp to outfit the kitchen of your restaurant or commercial food service operation with  equipment for meal prep, mixing, baking, broiling, and more.
about:
Attias Oven Corp. operates a showroom and fabrication shop at 270 42nd Street in Brooklyn, New York. The business is family-owned, though the founding year and founders' names are not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in the sale, service, and custom fabrication of commercial kitchen equipment. Its product line includes pizza and pita ovens, gyro machines, rotisseries and charbroilers, dough mixers, meat grinders, and custom-built machines tailored to restaurant kitchens. Equipment is described as handmade, with an emphasis on durability and fit for purpose.

Attias Oven Corp. serves restaurants and commercial food-service operations throughout the New York area. Typical customers include pizzerias, pita bakeries, Mediterranean eateries preparing gyros, shawarma, and falafel, as well as establishments needing rotisseries, charbroilers, mixers, and grinders.

The company highlights its in-depth experience and expert design capability for custom equipment, positioning itself as a local, family-owned specialist that builds machines to fit specific kitchen layouts and budgets.
